discussions.title: Wave-Particle Duality in Everyday Labs
discussions.subject: Physics
discussions.author: Dr. Aris Thorne
discussions.text: We recently tested single-photon interference patterns using an improvised double-slit setup. The results remarkably mirrored textbook quantum mechanical expectations, proving that even modest setups can capture wave-particle duality clearly.

discussions.title: Prime Numbers in Cryptographic Key Exchange
discussions.subject: Mathematics
discussions.author: Clara Montgomery
discussions.text: Exploring how large prime numbers form the unbreakable backbone of modern RSA encryption. Simple modular arithmetic yields profound security implications when scaled up exponentially.

discussions.title: Green Chemical Catalysts for Biodegradation
discussions.subject: Chemistry
discussions.author: Prof. Julian Vance
discussions.text: An accidental spill of plant-based enzymes accelerated polymer breakdown by over 40% in our lab. Sustainable chemistry continues to offer elegant solutions to stubborn waste problems.
